questions.question: Which of the following lists the types of radiation in the correct order of increasing penetrating power?
questions.explanation: Alpha particles are the least penetrating, and gamma rays are the most penetrating.
questions.source: AP Chemistry · Chapter 17 — Nuclear Chemistry, Q3

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct concerning β particles?
choices: They are electrons with a charge of +1 and are less penetrating than α particles.
They have a mass number of zero and a charge of +1.
They are electrons, with a mass number of zero and a charge of −1.
They have a mass number of zero, a charge of −1, and are less penetrating than α particles.
questions.explanation: In nuclear reactions, the mass of a β particle is treated as 0, with a charge of –1. Electrons and β particles are the same thing.
questions.source: AP Chemistry · Chapter 17 — Nuclear Chemistry, Q4

questions.question: If 75% of a sample of pure decays in 24.6 years, what is the half-life of?
questions.explanation: After one half-life, 50% would remain. After another half-life this would be reduced by one-half to 25%. The total amount decayed is 75%. Thus, 24.6 years must be two half-lives of 12.3 years each.
questions.source: AP Chemistry · Chapter 17 — Nuclear Chemistry, Q6
